items.content_text:
### Utils

*   [POMWright (⭐50)](https://github.com/DyHex/POMWright) - TypeScript-based framework designed for creating and maintaining Page Object Models. It streamlines locator management by automatically generating nested/chained locators from flat and atomic locator structures which can be dynamically updated throughout tests. This significantly reduces code duplication and makes tests easier to read, write, and maintain.
items.content_html:
Utils

  • POMWright (⭐50) - TypeScript-based framework designed for creating and maintaining Page Object Models. It streamlines locator management by automatically generating nested/chained locators from flat and atomic locator structures which can be dynamically updated throughout tests. This significantly reduces code duplication and makes tests easier to read, write, and maintain.
